Assess your capability

The Department of Customer Services, Open Data and Small and Family Business (CDSB) Digital Capability Team has developed an adapted DigComp capability assessment tool for the Queensland Government public sector workforce, with a particular focus on generalist roles. The assessment is designed to help employees understand their current digital capability, identify strengths and recognise opportunities for future capability development.

Current availability

The Queensland Government DigComp capability assessment is currently available only to participants involved in the proof-of-concept (PoC) phase.

Feedback from PoC participants will help inform future refinement of the assessment experience, capability descriptions and supporting learning resources.

At this stage the assessment is not available for broader public sector use.

Enquire about participating

To enquire about the Queensland Government DigComp capability assessment, contact:

DigitalICTcapability@chde.qld.gov.au
